test_inputs.explanation: The base_url and filter values were taken from the navigated URLs. The long 'filter/...' segment is a base64-encoded query that decodes to increment_id=100000031, order_increment_id=100000020, shipping_name=Jane%20Smith, and total_qty[from]=1 & total_qty[to]=1. The tool opened the shipment view at /view/shipment_id/34/, so view_details is true. export_format and mass_action are set to common demo options (CSV and PDF Packingslips) to match the demo flow behavior.
